plainText:
(Japanese: 火老賀タマル Tamaru Hirōga) is a character from Pokémon Battrio: Aim to be Battrio Master!.
 
==History==
Tamaru first appeared in ABM05 where he challenged Ryū to a Battrio match after defeating Yai Suba. The match wasn't fully shown except for the ending where Tamaru ended up beaten.
